subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU type, TPS & token mix
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU type, TPS & token mix

Alex — great to meet today, thanks for walking us through FinTechCo's use cases. Quick recap from my side and a few sizing questions so we can put together an accurate dedicated capacity proposal.

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: real-time risk scoring and transaction enrichment for fraud detection (API calls from production services).
- Primary requirement: predictable latency under load; looking at Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) with an option to evaluate Private VPC later for compliance.
- Preferred model family: evaluating Llama-3-style open family; will need to confirm exact model once we size.

Sizing questions / info we need from you:
1) Target steady-state TPS (inference requests per second) and expected peak bursts (how long do bursts last?)
2) Typical concurrency per request (do requests fan-out or are they single-shot) — e.g., how many simultaneous requests should we assume per instance?
3) Token mix: average prompt tokens vs average generated tokens (helps us estimate GPU memory and KV-cache needs).
4) Latency SLO (p50/p95 target) and max allowable tail latency.
5) Any requirement/preference for GPU generation (A100 vs H100) or quantization constraints (INT8/FP16).

Attached: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (blank template, please fill where you can). I also attached the call recording for reference.

Next steps: if you can send the TPS/concurrency/token numbers, I’ll loop in Marissa for pricing and Aditya for technical sizing and we’ll propose an instance mix and a short follow-up call to align.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-...)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Li <sophie.li@fintechco.com>, Procurement <procurement@fintechco.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU type, TPS & token mix

Thanks Rafael — quick answers below, filled a few fields in your template (see attached).

- Deployment mode: leaning toward Dedicated capacity (we want the predictability). Private VPC is a potential follow-on for regulated data but not required initially.
- Steady-state TPS: 3–5 rps for the core scoring endpoint.
- Peak bursts: up to ~12 rps for ~5–15 minute windows (batching of inbound events causes spikes during market opens).
- Concurrency: typical concurrency per instance ~8–10 concurrent in-flight requests (most are independent single-shot calls).
- Token mix: avg input prompt ~120 tokens; avg output ~220 tokens (we do some enrichment + verbose explanations for audit).
- Latency SLO: target p95 <= 350ms; p50 <= 80–100ms.
- Model preference: would prefer H100-capable instances if cost allows (we'd like headroom for 70B-class models in FP16 / tensor cores).
- Additional: Procurement asked for a ballpark monthly commit estimate so they can evaluate against the budget.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (filled)

Happy to hop on a short call next week to walk through.

—Alex

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template.xlsx (filled)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: GPU type, TPS & token mix

Alex — this is perfect, thanks for the detail. Summary and next steps below.

Summary based on your inputs:
- Deployment: Dedicated capacity (Private VPC optional later).
- Traffic: steady 3–5 TPS, spikes to ~12 TPS for short windows.
- Concurrency: plan for 8–10 concurrent request capacity per serving process.
- Token mix: 120 in / 220 out average.
- Latency target: p95 <= 350ms (we’ll size to hit p95 with some headroom).
- GPU preference: H100 recommended for 70B-class models; A100 is feasible if cost is a hard constraint.

Preliminary proposal (rough, will be validated by Aditya):
- For H100-based Dedicated pool: estimate 2–3 H100 nodes to comfortably handle steady-state + burst headroom with batching; we’ll tune batching K/V reuse to reduce token compute.
- If using A100: likely 3–4 nodes depending on quantization and model sharding.
- Monthly commit ballpark: I’ll have Marissa send a proposal range (we can do monthly or 12-month commit pricing).

Actions:
- Aditya: can you validate the node counts above (H100 vs A100) given 120/220 token mix and 8–10 concurrency assumptions? Please include expected p95 latency and a recommended instance mix.
- Marissa: can you provide a ballpark monthly commit estimate and any available discount guidance for a first-year commit?
- Alex/Procurement: if good, propose 30-min sizing + pricing call next Tue Apr 6 at 10:00am PDT (I’ll send a calendar invite once you confirm).

Attaching an updated sizing worksheet (redwood-dedicated-sizing-template-v2.xlsx) with our working assumptions. Also including a HubSpot link to the deal.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood-dedicated-sizing-template-v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-...); Link: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/FT-2024-089

Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity sizing follow-up: FinTechCo — action items

Team — forwarding FinTechCo thread and the filled template. Key asks below and please update the attached sizing sheet with estimates.

Key asks from customer:
- Dedicated capacity preferred; Private VPC could come later.
- Steady 3–5 TPS, burst to 12 TPS for short windows.
- Concurrency 8–10. Token mix 120 in / 220 out. Target p95 <= 350ms.
- They prefer H100 if cost allows; procurement asked for a monthly commit ballpark.

Please take ownership of the following:
- Aditya: propose an instance mix (H100 vs A100), node counts, expected p95 latency for the model class (assume Llama-3-ish 70B FP16), and any recommended batching/kv-cache settings to meet p95. Add numbers into redwood-dedicated-sizing-template-v2.xlsx.
- Marissa: prepare a ballpark pricing range for monthly commit (1/12/36-month options) and any promo/discount cadence we can offer for a first-year commitment. Include estimated MRC and the expected uplift if they choose Private VPC.
- Dylan: please review compliance implications if they later request Private VPC/on-prem — list typical timelines and blockers.

Can we aim to have the updated worksheet and pricing range by EOD Mon Apr 5 so Rafael can send a calendar invite for Tue Apr 6 10:00am PDT?

Thanks — Rafael
